plain_english_policy: This bill does not establish new laws or change policy; it is a ceremonial commendation recognizing specific Fayette County High School majorettes who joined the University of Alabama Crimsonettes.
policy_direction_if_enacted: Enactment would produce no substantive policy changes. The resolution serves solely to formally congratulate and honor five named individuals (Anna Ellis, Carly Oswalt, Laina McDonald) along with four existing members for their selection to perform as halftime performers for the Crimson Tide. It acknowledges a 25-year tradition of Fayette County graduates serving in this role and praises the local school system's training program.
sponsorship_supports_position: The sponsors support honoring these specific students for their achievement. They affirm that the Fayette County High School majorette program is exemplary and that these graduates deserve formal recognition from the House of Representatives.
evidence_quotes: COMMENDING FAYETTE COUNTY MEMBERS OF THE UNIVERSITY OF ALABAMA CRIMSONETTES.

BE IT RESOLVED BY THE HOUSE OF REPRESENTATIVES... That heartiest congratulations are extended to the Fayette County High School majorettes who were selected to join The University of Alabama Crimsonettes
this resolution is offered in highest tribute along with best wishes for continuing success in all their future endeavors.
